```{r, include=F}
library(lme4)
library(tidyverse)

sleep_study <- sleepstudy |>
  filter(Days >= 2) |>
  mutate(Days = Days - 2)

m1 <- lmer(Reaction ~ Days + (Days|Subject), sleep_study)

Gi <- Matrix::bdiag(VarCorr(m1))
```

## Last time: shrinkage

```{r echo=F, message=F, warning=F, fig.width=4, fig.height=3.5}
lmm_ests <- coef(m1)$Subject
colnames(lmm_ests) <- c("b0", "b1")
lmm_ests <- lmm_ests |>
  mutate(Subject = sort(unique(sleep_study$Subject))) |>
  select(Subject, b0, b1) |>
  mutate(method = "LMM")

ls_coefs <- matrix(nrow=18, ncol=2)
for(i in seq_along(unique(sleep_study$Subject))){
  sub_data <- sleep_study |>
    filter(Subject == unique(sleep_study$Subject)[i])
  m_sub <- lm(Reaction ~ Days, data = sub_data)
  ls_coefs[i,] <- coef(m_sub)
}

data.frame(Subject = unique(sleep_study$Subject),
           b0 = ls_coefs[,1],
           b1 = ls_coefs[,2],
           method = "Least squares within groups") |>
  rbind(lmm_ests) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = b0, y = b1)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = method, shape = method)) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_point(aes(x=268, y=11.44), size=2) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
